reason: E1 and E2 provide general support that laser-clad HEA coatings can improve TC4 hardness and wear resistance, but they do not mention the specific (TiAl)95-xCu5Nix composition or Ni effects. E3 directly supports the specific composition, Ni-induced microstructure, and property improvements, including the role of ~6 at.% Ni, though the cited text is truncated before full confirmation of optimal content. Overall, the key premises are mostly supported by accurately represented evidence, with a minor gap in the full confirmation of the 6 at.% Ni optimum.
